## Licence

OWID-produced data are CC BY 4.0. Third-party series keep their providers'
terms. Per the OWID codebook at the same commit:

- primary energy consumption: US EIA International Energy Data (2025) and the
  Energy Institute Statistical Review of World Energy (2025);
- coal, gas and oil production: Energy Institute (2025) and The Shift Data
  Portal (2019);
- GDP: Maddison Project Database 2023.
